headline: GPT-6 Astra reaches OpenAI's Critical cyber tier while external ARC-AGI-3 testing exposes a large provider-state-management effect
summary: OpenAI designated GPT-6 Astra its first Critical cybersecurity-capability model under its Preparedness Framework, reporting internal exploit-benchmark and expert assessments. Irregular’s separate public evaluation, conducted with OpenAI, reports Astra solved 86/226 FrontierCyber challenges versus 34/226 for GPT-5.6 Sol, achieved 59% versus 27% average CyScenarioBench success, and solved 20/22 Atomic Challenges. Irregular also reports that neither model solved an Elite challenge or successfully attacked a fully hardened target. These external results support a substantial capability increase in bounded test settings, while not independently reproducing OpenAI’s separate browser/OS chains or validating OpenAI’s Critical-tier decision. ARC Prize separately reports substantial Astra ARC-AGI-3 differences between its Standard and Provider Adapter harnesses, but the best-observed headline scores (62.7% and 99.9%) use different reasoning levels; matched-effort results remain sharply different (for example, 62.7% vs 98.6% at max, and 54.8% vs 99.9% at high). The result supports a harness-sensitive benchmark capability finding, not an isolated causal estimate of persistent state.
